meta.title: Hoi An Travel Guide 2026 🇻🇳 | Everything You Need to Know Before You Go
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Hoi An, Vietnam? 🇻🇳 This Hoi An Travel Guide 2026 covers everything you need to know before you go, from where to stay and how to get around to the best attractions, the best time to visit, and an easy 3-day itinerary.

Whether you're visiting Hoi An for the first time or adding it to your Vietnam itinerary, this guide will help you make the most of your trip while avoiding common tourist mistakes.

📍 In this Hoi An Travel Guide:
• A quick introduction to Hoi An
• How to get around Hoi An
• Where to stay (best areas)
• Best things to do in Hoi An
• Hoi An Ancient Town
• Coconut Basket Boat Tour
• Teh Dar Show
• Tra Que Vegetable Village
• An Bang Beach
• Lantern Boat Ride
• Best time to visit Hoi An
• Easy 3-day itinerary

Hoi An is one of Vietnam's most charming destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for its lantern-lit streets, incredible local food, beautiful beaches, and unique cultural experiences. In this guide, I'll share my honest recommendations to help you experience the very best of Hoi An.

If you found this video helpful, please 👍 Like, 💬 Leave a comment, and 🔔 Subscribe to WITHVAN for more Vietnam travel guides and Southeast Asia adventures!
